flattenedAtlas.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGETS input images1–4 are the four separate avatar clothes layers. Return ONE 2-column by2-row sprite atlas, ONE of each garment in input order left-to-right top-to-bottom: coral bomber/cream tee; navy cream stripe tee; lavender crewneck; olive open overshirt/cream tee. Preserve their garment shape, proportions, centered transparent U neck holes, straight horizontal bases, and simple color details. CRITICAL CHANGE: flatten ALL interior color regions completely. This is strict flat cut-paper colored geometry: every coral region one identical SOLID RGB coral, cream regions one solid warm cream, navy stripes one solid navy, lavender body one solid lavender, olive body one solid olive. Remove every trace of vignette, dither, light, gradient, brightness variation, paper/grain/noise/texture, shadows, glow, shading or modeling. No outlines. Lapels and collars are separate SIMPLE solid-color shapes, not shading. Raster equivalent of minimal vector fills, but native PNG. Absolutely no heads, neck/skin/hands/body or accessories added, no text or numbers, no decorations. Generous transparent margins/gutters between each of4full isolated garments; never touch. Real transparent alpha background outside silhouettes and in neck holes. 1536x1024 landscape atlas with equal768x512 cells. Make apparel simple and polished, no 3D.
